original: atha chommaṃ kathayetyādinimittadarśanamityantapañcadaśādipraśnacatuṣṭayavisarjanāyāha |
analyzed: atha chommam kathaya ityādi nimitta darśanam ityanta pañcadaśa ādi praśna catuṣṭaya visarjanāya āha

original: athetyādiyetyantaṃ chommanirdeśaḥ |
analyzed: atha ityādi yā ityantam

original: ḍākinītyādisarvabuddhamayohyasāvityantaṃ bāhyādhyātmapīṭhādinirdeśaḥ |
analyzed: ḍākinī ityādi sarva buddha mayaḥ hi asau ityantam bāhya adhyātma pīṭha ādi nirdeśaḥ

original: pīṭhamityādimānavaityantaṃ bhūminirdeśaḥ |
analyzed: pīṭham ityādi mānavaiti antam bhūmi nirdeśaḥ

original: bhramannityādiprajāyataityantaṃ nimittanirdeśaḥ |
analyzed: bhraman ityādi prajāyate etyantam nimitta nirdeśaḥ

original: tatra vāmahastaṃ tv iti vāmahastena | tur avadhāraṇa iti | yogīti yoginī, śīghraṃ siddhiḥ prajāyate yogina iti śeṣaḥ | athavā yena vijñāyate yoginaḥ śīghraṃ siddhiḥ prajāyate |
analyzed: tatra vāma hastam tu iti vāma hastena tuḥ avadhāraṇe iti yogī iti yoginī śīghram siddhiḥ prajāyate yoginaḥ iti śeṣaḥ athavā yena vijñāyate yoginaḥ śīghram siddhiḥ prajāyate

original: etad uktam. japadhyānaparasya yoginaḥ tiṣṭhataḥ pīṭhādau bhramato vā yoginyas tadanugrahāya saṃketair ātmānam upadarśayanti. yogināpi tāsāṃ saṃketān upalabhya pratisaṃketāḥ kartavyāḥ. tās tuṣṭāḥ samīhitāṃ siddhim upanayantīti. tatra yoginīnām aṅgasaṃketā vāmena. yoginas tu pratisaṃketā dakṣiṇena.
analyzed: etat uktam japa dhyāna parasya yoginaḥ tiṣṭhataḥ pīṭha ādau bhramataḥ vā yoginyaḥ tad anugrahāya saṃketaiḥ ātmānam upadarśayanti yoginā api tāsām saṃketān upalabhya pratisaṃketāḥ kartavyāḥ tāḥ tuṣṭāḥ samīhitām siddhim upanayanti iti tatra yoginīnām aṅga saṃketāḥ vāmena yoginaḥ tu pratisaṃketāḥ dakṣiṇena

original: ekāṅgulim iti tarjanī. yas tv iti yā. svāgatapraśna ity arthaḥ. dvābhyām iti tarjanīmadhyamābhyāṃ pratisaṃketaḥ. vāmāṅguṣṭhaṃ nipīḍayed iti tarjanīmadhyamābhyām iti śeṣaḥ. ittham eva dakṣiṇena pratimudrā. vāmāṅguliṃ niyojayed iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ. tadā tarjanīmadhyame yukte ity arthaḥ. pradeśiketi tarjanī. aṅguṣṭha iti kaścit.
analyzed: eka aṅgulim iti tarjanī yaḥ tu iti yā svāgata praśne iti arthaḥ dvābhyām iti tarjanī madhyamābhyām pratisaṃketaḥ vāma aṅguṣṭham nipīḍayet iti tarjanī madhyamābhyām iti śeṣaḥ ittham eva dakṣiṇena pratimudrā vāma aṅgulim niyojayet iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ tadā tarjanī madhyame yukte iti arthaḥ pradeśikā iti tarjanī aṅguṣṭhaḥ iti kaścid

original: anāmikāṃ darśayed iti spṛśed evaṃ grīvām. paṭṭiśam iti muṣṭiṃ baddhvā tarjanīmadhyame prasārya saṃśliṣṭe, lalāṭe dhāraṇāt. triśūlam iti vṛddhāṅguṣṭhena kanīyasīm āyantrya (anne: ākrāmya) śeṣāṅgulitrayavitataprasāraṇāt. medinīti bhuvam. dantān iti kaścit. cakram iti vṛddhātarjanībhyāṃ śliṣṭāgrābhyām. śikhām ity uṣṇīṣasparśāt.
analyzed: anāmikām darśayet iti spṛśet evam grīvām paṭṭiśam iti muṣṭim baddhvā tarjanī madhyame prasārya saṃśliṣṭe lalāṭe dhāraṇāt triśūlam iti vṛddha aṅguṣṭhena kanīyasīm āyantrya anne ākrāmya śeṣa aṅguli traya vitata prasāraṇāt medinī iti bhuvam dantān iti kaścid cakram iti vṛddhā tarjanībhyām śliṣṭa agrābhyām śikhām iti uṣṇīṣa sparśāt

original: krīḍake kandukena tv ity ubhābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ nartitaṃ darśayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: krīḍake kandukena tu iti ubhābhyām hastābhyām nartitam darśayet iti arthaḥ

original: kāyavākcittaceṣṭāto 'pi vijñāya tāḥ sevanīyā ity āha— vāmenetyādi. vāmeneti vāmapādena. gamanādau ḍākinyā iti prathamā. vāmata iti puruṣasyeti. vāmahastaprabhāṣī ceti vāmahastam unnāmya prabhāṣaṇaśīlā. pravāmaṃ natvoccaiḥ śabdaṃ karotīti kaścit.
analyzed: vijñāya tāḥ sevanīyāḥ iti āha vāmena ityādi vāmena iti vāma pādena gamana ādau ḍākinyāḥ iti prathamā vāmatas iti puruṣasya iti vāma hasta prabhāṣī ca iti vāma hastam unnāmya prabhāṣaṇa śīlā pravāmam natvā uccais śabdam karoti iti kaścid

original: strīṇāṃ hṛṣṭaprabhāṣī ceti strībhyaḥ sarasālāpinī. samayī so 'bhidhīyata iti sā samayinīty arthaḥ. strīṇāṃ prārthitam iti tābhyo 'bhyarthya samayasevāṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ. kulabījair iti vairocanādibījaiḥ.
analyzed: strīṇām hṛṣṭa prabhāṣī ca iti strībhyaḥ sarasa ālāpinī samayī saḥ abhidhīyate iti sā samayinī iti arthaḥ strīṇām prārthitam iti tābhyaḥ bhyarthya samaya sevām kuryāt iti arthaḥ kula bījaiḥ iti vairocana ādi bījaiḥ

original: kulakriyeti yasmin kule samutpannā tatkulakriyām. japati svakulam iti svakulamantram. vidyā saṃlikhyate sadeti svamantraṃ pṛcchatīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: kula kriyā iti yasmin kule samutpannā tad kula kriyām japati sva kulam iti sva kula mantram vidyā saṃlikhyate sadā iti sva mantram pṛcchati iti arthaḥ

original: likhet svagṛhe ramed iti pūjayitveti śeṣaḥ. ḍākinīkulasaṃbhūteti vajravārāhīkulasambhavā |
analyzed: likhet sva gṛhe ramet iti pūjayitvā iti śeṣaḥ ḍākinī kula saṃbhūtā iti vajra vārāhī kula sambhavā

original: deśe deśe ityādi subodham.
analyzed: deśe deśe ityādi su bodham

original: tatpiṇḍamayam iti teṣāṃ pullīrādicaturviṃśatideśānāṃ pīṭhādidaśasaṃgṛhītānāṃ tatsthānāñ ca pracaṇḍādidevīkhaṇḍakapālavīryāṇāṃ yaḥ piṇḍa ekatra samāveśa tatsvabhāvo yogino dehaḥ. ata evāha— sarvetyādi.  adhimātrayoginā svaśarīra eva sakalam etan niṣpādyam iti bhāvaḥ. adhyātmāsamarthenaiva bāhyapīṭhādau patitavyam (anne paryaṭitavyam).
analyzed: tat piṇḍa mayam iti teṣām pullīra ādi caturviṃśati deśānām pīṭha ādi daśa saṃgṛhītānām tad sthānām ca pracaṇḍa ādi devī khaṇḍa kapāla vīryāṇām yaḥ piṇḍe ekatra samāveśa tad svabhāvaḥ yoginaḥ dehaḥ atas eva āha sarva ityādi adhimātra yoginā sva śarīre eva sakalam etat niṣpādyam iti bhāvaḥ adhyātma asamarthena eva bāhya pīṭha ādau patitavyam anne paryaṭitavyam

original: tad uktaṃ śrīabhidhānottare—
kṣīyante dhātavas teṣāṃ bhramaṇād bāhya yoginām |
analyzed: kṣīyante dhātavaḥ teṣām bhramaṇāt yoginām

original: ato bāhyaṃ nirākṛtya sthātavyaṃ yogalīlayā ||
analyzed: atas bāhyam nirākṛtya sthātavyam yoga līlayā

original: yadi tattvavihīnāḥ syur bhrāntyā teṣāṃ na kiṃcana |
analyzed: yadi tattva vihīnāḥ syuḥ bhrāntyā teṣām na kiṃcana

original: atha tattvayutās teṣu bhrāntyān teṣāṃ na kiṃcana || iti |
analyzed: atha tattva yutāḥ teṣu bhrāntyāt teṣām na kiṃcana iti

original: atha vādhyātmaṃ japabhāvanādilabdhasāmarthyo devyādeśād bahiḥ pīṭhādiyātrāṃ kuryād iti bahiḥkṣetrādiṣu caryāparyaṭanaṃ hetubhūtam adhyātmaparikīrtanam iti. ata eva vakṣyati—
analyzed: atha vā adhyātmam japa bhāvanā ādi labdha sāmarthyaḥ devī ādeśāt bahis pīṭha ādi yātrām kuryāt iti bahis kṣetra ādiṣu caryā paryaṭanam hetu bhūtam adhyātma parikīrtanam iti atas eva vakṣyati

original: bāhyayogini saṃpūjyā pīṭhabhramaṃ na śakyate | iti |
analyzed: bāhya yogini saṃpūjyā pīṭha bhramam na śakyate iti

original: nānāvidhā hi vineyānāṃ puṇyaparipākā iti pūrvakenāsya na virodhaḥ.
analyzed: nānāvidhāḥ hi vineyānām puṇya paripākāḥ iti pūrvakena asya na virodhaḥ

original: bhramann iti pīṭhādau. nimittam iti yoginīnāṃ veṣṭitam. tad evāha nānetyādi. vyāghrādirūpeṇa krodharūpeṇa ca kāścid āgacchanti yoginaḥ saṃnidhānam. hā hetyādi bhīmo 'ṭṭahāsaṃ (anne hāhetyādibhīmāṭṭahāsaṃ) ca hasanti. tatra yoginābhetavyam (anne yoginā na bhetavyam) iti. kartavyaṃ punaḥ kim ity āha svādhītyādi.
analyzed: bhraman iti pīṭha ādau nimittam iti yoginīnām veṣṭitam tat eva āha nānā ityādi vyāghra ādi rūpeṇa krodha rūpeṇa ca kāścid āgacchanti yoginaḥ saṃnidhānam hā hā ityādi bhīmaḥ u ṭṭahāsam anne hā hā ityādi bhīma aṭṭahāsam ca hasanti tatra yoginā a bhetavyam anne yoginā na bhetavyam iti kartavyam punar kim iti āha svādhi ityādi

original: śrīvajravārāhyāliṅgitaḥ śrīsamvararūpam ālambya hūṃkāranādaḥ kartavya ity arthaḥ. tad evāha siṃhetyādi. darśanasparśanam ity upalakṣaṇam, vacanādiśravaṇād apīti boddhavyam iti.
analyzed: śrī vajravārāhī āliṅgitaḥ śrī samvara rūpam ālambya hūṃkāra nādaḥ kartavyaḥ iti arthaḥ tat eva āha siṃha ityādi darśana sparśanam iti upalakṣaṇam vacana ādi śravaṇāt api iti boddhavyam iti

original: navamapaṭalavyākhyā ||
analyzed: navama paṭala vyākhyā
